Premise: holds
Serial constraints cleared: PR #36208 (seat 1, #36076) also edits every locale file; key values only, so the thread runs `overlap-check.mjs` before each push and reports a textual overlap instead of merging around it. No other open PR touches the locale files.

Pre-claim lane: `ui/packages/i18n/**` (`domain:ui`), not governed. Values change, no key is added or removed, so the published key set is unchanged.
Pre-claim deps: the card names no `Blocked-by:` and no "after #N".
Prior rulings read: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 36148 --terms streamActivity,noActivity,timeline,动态` at c30ce97c: 0 hits; none. Governing text: #27524 (the timeline is 「动态」). The new words follow the card's own first examples (filter 「变更」, empty state 「暂无动态」, en filter "Changes"); the PR says so, and the area stops if a reading shows another word is needed.
Fold-or-serial: no fold; no other a4-G card touches the timeline wording, and the in-flight a4-G cards touch no locale file.

Ruling: letter A · maintainer 「A 改叫「事件」」 · 2026-11-22T04:46Z

The maintainer (Leehom) tapped option A on the decision card in the project's decision thread `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4H6fee7fzjxSXBsEqp9rr4` (card `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMF55eaSXnRHjuqRuuEi1gY`, choice record `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XLPnEZRr9Rok2y31yvSMfPG`, 2026-11-22T04:45:12Z). It answers the open question of report 7074043324. The option text on the card: 「筛选变成 全部 · 事件 · 讨论 · 变更,英文叫 Events;空状态「暂无动态」,旧标题「动态」。」

**Ruled, the three strings:**

1. **The filter** (`detail.streamActivity`): zh-Hans 「事件」, zh-Hant 「事件」, en `Events`. The row reads 「全部 · 事件 · 讨论 · 变更」. Ruling 6649643659 (#30074, option C) is unchanged: the chip holds what it held, only its name changes.
2. **The empty state** (`detail.noActivity`): zh-Hans 「暂无动态」, zh-Hant 「暫無動態」. It is the panel's one empty state and draws under every chip (both `filtered.length === 0` branches of `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`), so it takes the stream's word, not the chip's. en stays `No activity recorded`.
3. **`detail.activity`** (the legacy activity tab, the legacy card title, the panel's default title, an authored `Activity` tab label): zh-Hans 「动态」, zh-Hant 「動態」, the same word as `detail.timeline`, as in the other nine packs. en stays `Activity`.

Not taken: B 「记录」/`Updates`, C 「操作」/`Actions`, D keep 「活动」.

**Execution (from the decision thread's analysis; items below this line are the thread's reading, not text on the tapped card):**

- The other eight packs take their own word for "events" on `detail.streamActivity`: de `Ereignisse`, es `Eventos`, fr `Événements`, ja `イベント`, ko `이벤트`, pt-BR `Eventos`, ru `События`, ar `الأحداث`. Each of them has the same tab-and-chip pair as en today.
- Three more strings of the same panel say 「活动」 for the stream and go to 「动态」 in the same PR (zh-Hans and zh-Hant only): `detail.activityAccessDenied`, `detail.activityLoadFailed`, `detail.filterActivity`. `detail.allActivity` is already 「全部动态」.
- The en chip's in-code fallback follows the pack: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx:209` (`fallback: 'Activity'`). That file is outside the claim's declared surface (locale packs) and is not a seat-1 hot file; the card thread declares it in its report.
- Values only: no key added, renamed or removed. Clause-②: no. Metadata-protocol: none. ⛔ Not `RecordDetailView.tsx` or `RelatedList.tsx`.
- The card thread (branch `claude/project-thread-r2g68m`, claim 7074019286) resumes and checks the card's done-when on a hotcrm lead page.

Stated to the maintainer before the tap: an app object labelled 「事件」 would collide the same way; none is measured today.

Prior rulings read: streamactivity,streamchanges,noactivity,timeline,动态,活动,事件 → 0 hits; none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack (plus 6649643659 on #30074, read).
